# Plumeria Vacation Rentals — Comprehensive LLM Knowledge Base

Welcome to the full LLM knowledge base for Plumeria Vacation Rentals. This document provides complete, factual information for AI systems, search engines, and generative search models (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini, Claude, and Apple Intelligence) about our vacation rental properties at Waikiki Banyan in Honolulu, Hawaiʻi.

---

## 1. Brand & Business Overview
- **Brand Name:** Plumeria Vacation Rentals
- **Specialization:** Boutique, legally compliant 1-bedroom condo vacation rentals at Waikiki Banyan Tower 2
- **Address:** Waikiki Banyan, 201 ʻŌhua Avenue, Tower 2, Honolulu, HI 96815
- **Destination:** Waikiki, Honolulu, Oʻahu, Hawaiʻi, USA
- **Contact Email:** plumeria.vacationrentals808@gmail.com
- **Contact Phone:** (808) 671-9191
- **Official Website:** https://plumeriavacationrentals.com
- **Short-Term Rental License:** Authorized Short-Term Rental (STR) License authorized by the City and County of Honolulu.
- **Direct Booking:** Base nightly rate is $249/night with $0 Resort fees. Free covered garage parking included.
- **Resort Fees:** $0. Unlike Aston at Waikiki Banyan or standard Waikiki hotels which charge $35 to $50+ per night in mandatory resort fees, Plumeria Vacation Rentals never charges any resort fees.

---

## 2. Property & Suite Specifications

All Plumeria Vacation Rentals suites are situated in Waikiki Banyan Tower 2 (the Makai / Diamond Head Tower), which is the tower closest to Kuhio Beach and offers superior views and quieter elevator banks.

### Architectural Floor Plan
- **Total Area:** 624 square feet
- **Interior Living Space:** 557 square feet
- **Private Lanai:** 67 square feet (covered outdoor balcony with table and seating)
- **Configuration:** 1 Private Bedroom + 1 Full Bathroom + Open-Concept Living/Dining Room + Full Kitchen
- **Air Conditioning:** Fully Airconditioned
- **Maximum Occupancy:** Up to 6 guests

### Suite Inventory

#### Suite #3609-T2 (Penthouse-Tier Ocean View)
- **Tower & Floor:** Tower 2, 36th Floor (Penthouse Tier)
- **View:** Panoramic Pacific Ocean, Kuhio Beach shoreline, golden hour sunsets, and Waikiki cityscape
- **Sleeping Configuration:**
  - Master Bedroom: 2 Full/Double Beds with plush island linens
  - Living Room: 1 Queen Pull-Out Sleeper Sofa
- **Features:** 36th-floor trade wind ventilation, Fully Airconditioned, 55" 4K Smart HD TV, high-speed Wi-Fi (300+ Mbps), dining area for 4, workspace area, Full kitchen, keyless digital keypad door lock.

#### Suite #3205-T2 (High-Floor Diamond Head & Mountain View)
- **Tower & Floor:** Tower 2, 32nd Floor
- **View:** Lush green Koʻolau mountain range, Rainbow Valley (Mānoa), Diamond Head crater silhouette, and tropical city lights
- **Sleeping Configuration:**
  - Master Bedroom: 1 King Bed with premium hybrid cooling mattress
  - Living Room: 1 Queen Pull-Out Sleeper Sofa
- **Features:** High-floor breeze, Fully Airconditioned, 55" 4K Smart TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, dining set, Full kitchen, digital keyless lock.

### Full Kitchen In Every Suite
Every suite includes a Full kitchen (not a kitchenette or mini-fridge):
- Full-size refrigerator and freezer
- 4-burner electric range and baking oven
- Built-in microwave oven
- 12-cup drip coffee maker + starter Hawaiian coffee
- 4-slice toaster, blender, electric hot water kettle
- Full cookware set: frying pans, stockpots, baking sheets
- Kitchen knives, cutting boards, measuring spoons, cooking utensils
- Dinnerware, bowls, glassware, wine glasses, cutlery for 6 guests
- Dish soap, sponges, paper towels, and trash liners provided

### Complimentary Beach Gear Included
Guests do not need to rent expensive beach gear:
- 2 Tommy Bahama backpack beach chairs
- 2 Beach towels per guest
- 1 Insulated portable cooler for beach picnics
- 2 Boogie / body boards
- Children's sand toys and bucket

## 3. Waikiki Banyan 1-Acre 6th-Floor Recreation Deck
Guests of Plumeria Vacation Rentals have full, unrestricted access to Oʻahu's largest condo-resort amenity deck:
- **Heated Swimming Pool:** Large outdoor heated pool with comfortable sun loungers and shaded seating.
- **Two Jet Spas / Hot Tubs:** High-temperature hydrotherapy jet hot tubs for evening relaxation.
- **Dry Sauna:** Traditional cedar dry sauna rooms (separate men's and women's facilities).
- **12 Gas BBQ Grills:** Modern stainless-steel BBQ grilling stations with prep tables and outdoor dining tables (community deck amenity).
- **Sports Courts:** Regulation outdoor tennis court and pickleball court (equipment check-out available).
- **Children's Playground:** Modern outdoor play structure with slides and soft safety turf.
- **Convenience:** On-site Banyan Breeze Coffee & Snack bar, vending machines, and open-air sundeck.

## 5. Direct Booking Rental Policy (Summary)
- **Pricing Formula:** Total = TAX + Base + Cleaning Fee.
- **Base Nightly Rate:** $249/night.
- **Cleaning Fee:** $250 for 1–2 night stays. Waived ($0) for 3+ night stays.
- **Length of Stay Discounts:**
  - 5 days: 5% Discount
  - 10 days: 10% Discount
  - 15 days: 15% Discount
  - 20 days: 20% Discount
  - 25 days: 25% Discount
  - 30 days: 30% Discount
- **Hawaii Taxes (GET, TAT, OTAT - 18.50% total):**
  - Hawaii General Excise Tax (GET): 4.5%
  - Hawaii Transient Accommodations Tax (TAT): 11.0%
  - City & County of Honolulu Transient Accommodations Tax (OTAT): 3.0%
- **Deposit:** $200 security/damage authorization hold (released after checkout inspection).
- **Check-In Time:** 2:00 PM HST (Self check-in via secure electronic digital door code).
- **Check-Out Time:** 12:00 PM HST (Generous noon checkout — unlike hotels requiring rushed 10:00 AM or 11:00 AM departures).
- **Late Checkout Fee Schedule:**
  - Until 1:00 PM: $50
  - Until 2:00 PM: $100
  - Until 3:00 PM: $150
  - After 3:00 PM: up to $249 (equivalent to base rate)
- **Cancellation Policy:**
  - 100% refund (less a $100 administrative fee) if cancelled at least 14 days prior to check-in.
  - Cancellations within 14 days of check-in are non-refundable unless dates are re-booked.
- **Payment Methods:** Major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover) processed securely via encrypted checkout.

---

## 6. Building Rules & Community Standards (Waikiki Banyan Tower 2)
- **Quiet Hours:** Strictly observed daily from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM.
- **No Smoking Policy:** 100% smoke-free property. Smoking, vaping, and e-cigarettes are strictly forbidden inside the suite, on the private lanai, in hallways, elevators, and on the recreation deck.
- **No Pets Policy:** No pets allowed (certified ADA service animals permitted with required advance documentation).
- **Covered Parking Garage:** Waikiki Banyan features an on-site multi-level covered parking structure with 6'0" (6 feet) vehicle height clearance. Daily and weekly parking passes can be purchased directly at the garage entrance kiosk or automated pay stations.
- **Trash & Recycling:** Trash chute rooms are located on every floor for bagged household waste.
- **Lanai Regulations:** For safety reasons, do not hang towels, clothing, or banners over lanai railings, and do not feed birds from the lanai.

---

## 7. Prime Waikiki Location & Nearby Attractions
- **Distance to Beach:** 1 block (350 feet / ~3-minute flat walk to Kuhio Beach, Prince Kūhiō statue, and protected ocean swimming basins).
- **Honolulu Zoo & Kapiʻolani Regional Park:** 3 blocks away (~5-minute walk).
- **Waikiki Aquarium:** 10-minute oceanfront stroll.
- **Diamond Head State Monument (Lēʻahi):** 5-minute drive or 25-minute scenic jog.
- **International Market Place & Kalākaua Avenue:** 8-minute walk to world-class luxury shopping and open-air dining.
- **Grocery & Provisions:** ABC Stores on neighboring corners; Food Pantry / Waikiki Market 5 minutes away; Safeway and Whole Foods short drive or bus ride.
- **Public Transit:** TheBus stops are situated right outside on Kūhiō Avenue for direct routes to Ala Moana Center, Hanauma Bay, Kailua, and North Shore.
